sources.excerpt: SurfGuitars.com : Menatone Ms. Foxy Brown Overdrive Guitar Pedal : Menatone Pedals Surf Guitars Home Electric Guitars - Danelectro Guitars - Fender Guitars - Gibson Guitars - Eastwood Airline Guitars Acoustic Guitars - Martin Guitars - Taylor Guitars - Gibson Acoustic Guitars - Takamine Guitars Guitar Effects Pedals - Menatone Guitar Pedals - Fulltone Guitar Pedals Classical Nylon Guitars Guitar Amplifiers - Fender Amplifiers - Marshall Amplifiers Bass Guitars Surf Guitars Home » Guitar Effects Pedals » Menatone Guitar Pedals  » Menatone Ms. Foxy Brown Overdrive Guitar Pedal Menatone Ms. Foxy Brown Overdrive Guitar Pedal Guitar Effects Pedals from Menatone Pedals Menatone Ms. Foxy Brown Overdrive Guitar Pedal Menatone Ms. Foxy Brown Overdrive Guitar Pedal from Menatone Guitar Pedals The new Menatone Foxy Brown guitar pedal was inspired by those cool old British 18 watt amplifiers. It is crunchy, raw, and total rock-and-roll. The tone control works a bit differently from most pedals. From noon down, it cuts highs. From noon up, it cuts bass. All the midrange remains untouched. The unique SAG control simulates the compression of a tube rectifier as it is turned up. Menatone Foxy Brown Overdrive Features: All analog circuit Ultra bright LED Easy access battery True bypass switching External Power Supply Jack [- center, + ring] Silver Plater, Teflon coated wire Shielded wire from input and output jacks to switch Only carbon resistors and film capacitors in signal path Menatone Foxy Brown Overdrive Pictures Previous Models
